verdict.rationale: Sift ingests your own behavioral data through the Events API, client data through the JS snippet and iOS/Android SDKs, and custom metadata through custom events and fields. It also takes your business decisions via the Decisions API and historical backfill, stating that it 'gets smarter the more data it has about your business.' The founder confirms that JS and REST signals jointly inform detection. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that device fingerprints are collected or can be supplied, explicit confirmation that custom fields feed the model's scoring rather than only being stored, and independent hands-on corroboration of per-customer model tuning.
